title: Merchandising basics

captions.instagram:
Your layout talks before your staff does.

I broke merchandising into the path every customer takes: enter, browse, decide, buy. Swipe for what you control at each step, then save the 6 layout rules.

#Retail #Merchandising #SmallBusiness

What's your best layout tip?
captions.facebook:
Cluttered or clear? A store layout guides customers from the door to the register, on purpose or by accident. I put 6 layout rules on the last slide.

#Retail #SmallBusiness

What's the first thing you notice when you walk into a store?
captions.linkedin:
A layout should guide customers on purpose, not by accident.

Every customer follows the same path: enter, browse, decide, buy. You control four things along it: the entrance (show your clearest offer first), the flow (make the path easy), the grouping (related products together) and the signage (prices and promotions easy to read).

My six layout rules: strong entrance, clear path, related items together, visible prices, planned promotions, clean and consistent displays.

#Retail #Merchandising

Which rule does your store break most often?
